items.question: Did Harrowgate give the change of control notice that the MSA requires, and how long before completion?
items.answer:
Harrowgate gave the change of control notice that the MSA requires. The notice was sent on 3 September 2026 [1].

The notice was given thirty days before completion. The completion date was expected on 15 October 2026 [1], and the notice was sent on 3 September 2026, which is thirty days prior [1].

The MSA requires at least thirty days' prior written notice of any Change of Control [3].

items.question: What service credit applies to downtime, and what monthly fee is it calculated on?
items.answer:
The service credit for downtime is 5% of the monthly subscription fee, as stated in the Harrowgate Systems Inc. side letter. The source states: "For each full hour of unavailability below that level, Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee" [1].

The monthly fee on which the service credit is calculated is the platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month. This is stated in the Harrowgate MSA: "Client shall pay a platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform" [3].

The service credit is capped at 25% of the monthly subscription fee, as stated in the side letter: "Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month" [1].

items.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
